margin_pool.moving_toward: Advanced packaging and test: CoWoS-class capacity (TSM), inspection/metrology steps per wafer as gate-all-around and hybrid bonding ramp (KLAC), and test seconds per die as die sizes and HBM stack counts rise (TER). The incremental AI dollar buys packaging and test capacity, not another scanner.
margin_pool.moving_away_from: Mature-node front-end wafer tools, and lithography UNIT count. ASML's EUV ASP rises but unit growth is gated by High-NA adoption pace, so its share of each incremental AI capex dollar falls even with the monopoly fully intact. Also away from fabless silicon pricing power relative to the upstream bottleneck.

Margin-pool call for this cluster, stated so a future run can test it: profit is migrating TOWARD advanced packaging and test (CoWoS at TSM, inspection steps per wafer at KLAC, test seconds per die at TER) and AWAY FROM lithography UNIT count and mature-node front-end tools. Testable at TSMC's 10-15 capex split and ASML's 10-14 bookings.
